signals.label: Climate, 1977 to 2003
signals.say: Publicly, the company stressed doubt about climate science.
signals.record: A 2023 peer-reviewed study found most of its own scientists’ temperature projections between 1977 and 2003 matched the warming that followed.

signals.label: Product claims, 2015
signals.say: The company marketed its diesel cars as “clean diesel.”
signals.record: The US EPA found software in the cars that detected emissions tests and reduced controls in normal driving. Volkswagen later pleaded guilty to US criminal charges.

signals.label: Reporting, 2011
signals.say: Each signed up to the UN Global Compact’s ten principles on human rights, labour, environment and anti-corruption.
signals.record: By January 2011 they had been expelled for repeatedly failing to report their progress.

signals.label: Supply chain, 2001 to 2020
signals.say: In 2001 the industry’s Harkin–Engel Protocol pledged to end the worst forms of child labour in cocoa, with a 2005 target.
signals.record: Deadlines were pushed back repeatedly, and a 2020 University of Chicago (NORC) study still found widespread child labour in cocoa farming in Côte d’Ivoire and Ghana.
